"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The United States will pursue strengthened diplomacy with Iran alongside European allies, without preconditions.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"If Iran abandons its nuclear weapons program, support for terror, and threats to Israel, it will receive meaningful incentives.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"So long as Iran refuses to abandon its nuclear weapons program, support for terror, and threats to Israel, the United States and the international community will further ratchet up the pressure with stronger unilateral sanctions.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"So long as Iran refuses to abandon its nuclear weapons program, support for terror, and threats to Israel, the United States and the international community will further ratchet up the pressure with stronger multilateral sanctions inside and outside the U.N. Security Council.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"So long as Iran refuses to abandon its nuclear weapons program, support for terror, and threats to Israel, the United States and the international community will pursue sustained action to isolate the Iranian regime.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"It is Iran, not the United States, choosing isolation over cooperation.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"By going the extra diplomatic mile, while keeping all options on the table, it is more likely the rest of the world will stand with the United States to increase pressure on Iran if diplomacy is failing.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The United States supports a diplomatic effort to secure a verifiable end to North Korea's nuclear weapons program.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The United States supports fully accounting for and securing any fissile material or weapons North Korea has produced to date.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The United States will continue direct diplomacy with North Korea.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The United States is committed to working with partners through the six-party talks to ensure that all agreements are fully implemented in the effort to achieve a verifiably nuclear-free Korean peninsula.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
